theorems.name: Submission.idtp_fons_odc_ra_action_split
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1) (F : Finset (Euclid P)), (∀ e ∈ F, ‖e‖ = 1) → (μHE[1] : Measure (Euclid P)) (R.carrier ∩ (⋃ e ∈ F, (fun t : ℝ => t • e) '' Ioi 0)ᶜ) = 0 → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1, R.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 1) = ∑ e ∈ F, ∫ x in R.carrier ∩ (fun t : ℝ => t • e) '' Ioi 0, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 1) x) ∂μHE[1]
